mapper.sql: cosd.id AS id, cosd.crm_opportunity_id AS crmOpportunityId, cosd.customer_id AS customerId, cosd.image_name AS imageName, cosd.image_url AS imageUrl, cosd.start_date AS startDate, cosd.end_date AS endDate, cosd.address AS address, cosd.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, cosd.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM crm_opportunity_documents AS cosd LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = cosd.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = cosd.modified_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_opportunity_documents ( crm_opportunity_id , customer_id, image_name, image_url, start_date, end_date, address, is_active, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{document.crmOpportunityId}, #{document.customerId}, #{document.imageName}, #{document.imageUrl}, #{document.startDate}, #{document.endDate}, #{document.address}, 1, NOW(), #{document.createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_opportunity_documents SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
